name: Kathrein Margit
beschreibung: The guesthouse Kathrein Margit welcomes travelers to a quiet, sunny neighborhood in Reutte in Tyrol's Außerfern region. Surrounded by the striking peaks of the Lechtal and Ammergau Alps, this family-managed home radiates warm, personalized hospitality. Spacious rooms and holiday apartments feature scenic balconies framing the alpine panorama. Guests start their morning with a wholesome breakfast featuring local products. Its setting in the Reutte Nature Park region offers a wealth of adventures: from the highline179 suspension bridge and historic Ehrenberg Castle to the Alpentherme thermal baths, pristine Lake Plansee, and winter ski slopes.
kurzbeschreibung: Welcoming family guesthouse in Reutte in the Nature Park region offering scenic balconies and mountain views.
